summary: Scoped student-account creation and LRN retirement checks pass. This is not a full-database security certification.
verified: Assigned active teachers can create constrained student profiles.
Admin cannot create student profiles or convert existing staff profiles into students.
Admin can still create teacher accounts and deactivate existing staff.
Other teachers, inactive teachers and forged invitation fields are rejected.
Admin, teacher and student writes to the retired LRN namespaces are rejected.
Historical LRN records remain readable by Admin and are not deleted.
The server invitation handler rejects Admin overrides and inactive teachers.

findings.issue: Existing rules still broadly allow authenticated writes to collections outside users, students and the retired LRN namespaces, including class records. Existing profile reads and subcollection access are also broad.
findings.recommendation: Audit and migrate those collections separately with their current application queries and workflows; do not interpret this scoped change as complete database hardening.
